legal_units.title: Deduction in case of a person with disability.
legal_units.text: An individual, being resident in India, who is certified by a medical authority, at any time during the tax year, as a person with disability or person with severe disability, shall be allowed a deduction of Rs. 75000 or Rs. 125000, respectively, while computing his total income.
